notes.title: New version + now compatible Mac
notes.notes:
Hi tennis-fans!

We wanted to let you know that an update has been pushed to Steam. This new version of Smoots World Cup Tennis is now [b]Mac compatible[/b], the Turkish language has been added and a few bugs have been fixed (some issues with the pad and sound settings).

Have fun!
